name: Hip_Dance
description: A simple hands-on-hips dance with a gentle side-to-side hip sway and planted shoes.
notes: One intact whole-character drawing is rendered through a continuous smooth hip-sway mapping at 30 fps over 1600 ms. The pelvis moves twelve source pixels each way; the full head and collar band remain fixed. Motion tapers smoothly to zero above the shoes. The vertical map is continuous, with a subpixel settling motion. All pixels sample the original artwork once with premultiplied-alpha bilinear filtering. There are no separated arms, torso, shorts or leg layers, no crossfaded poses and no independently scaled frames. Forty-eight rendered frames are not forty-eight independently drawn poses. The generated pose sheet and rejected pose-switch sequence remain recoverable; stage 1 supplies the intact canonical art. Common scale normalization follows. Scale v6: one fixed whole-character transform per clip, matched to the standing-idle median opaque head silhouette area. It includes eyes/mouth, so blinking does not change the scale estimate. No frame-specific scaling, head/body cuts, or pose-height normalization. Grounded contacts remain y592; flight clearance is transformed about the shared root. Pose projection, breathing and original drawing proportions remain intact.
